observations: Four kettles are shown in different colors: blue, red, green, and stainless steel.
All kettles have a classic rounded body, black plastic handle, and a spout with a lid and whistle mechanism.
Photo 0 shows each kettle from a front-three-quarter angle, placed on a surface.

Photo 1 shows all four kettles together on a wooden surface with Chinese text overlays: '鸣音水壶' (whistling kettle), '优质不锈钢' (high-quality stainless steel), '水开即鸣 不挑炉灶' (whistles when water boils, works on any stove), '加厚聚能壶底 各种炉具均适用' (thickened energy-concentrating base, suitable for all stoves), and '平底设计循环加热' (flat bottom design for cyclic heating).
Photo 2 shows a red kettle being poured into a glass, demonstrating its use.
No brand or model is visible on any kettle in any photo.
The kettles appear to be made of coated metal (colored) or stainless steel (silver one), with black plastic handles and lids.
The Chinese text suggests the product is marketed as high-quality stainless steel with a flat bottom for all stoves and a whistle that activates when water boils.

claims.evidence: No capacity marking is visible in any photo. The size appears consistent with a 3L kettle, but cannot be confirmed remotely.
The silver kettle appears to be stainless steel, but the colored kettles are coated. The Chinese text says '优质不锈钢' (high-quality stainless steel), but this is not verifiable from the photos alone.
All kettles have a visible whistle mechanism on the lid, and the Chinese text says '水开即鸣' (whistles when water boils).

The Chinese text says '不挑炉灶' (not picky about stove), but no proof of compatibility with gas, electric, or induction is visible. The flat bottom design is shown, but induction compatibility cannot be confirmed.

risks.proof: A photo showing the kettle filled with water and a measuring scale or a known reference object to confirm volume.
risks.if_unproven: priced as a smaller capacity kettle, likely 1.5L-2L

risks.risk: The colored kettles may not be stainless steel but coated metal, which can chip or degrade
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the base and body showing material texture and any coating, or a scratch test video.
risks.if_unproven: priced as lower-quality coated metal, not stainless steel

risks.risk: The kettle may not work on induction stoves
risks.proof: A photo or video showing the kettle on an induction cooktop with a working indicator light or heat.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not induction-compatible, reducing value for buyers with induction stoves

risks.risk: The whistle may not function properly
risks.proof: A video of the kettle boiling water and the whistle activating.

proof_requests: A photo or video showing the kettle filled to the brim with water and a measuring scale or reference object to confirm 3L capacity.
A close-up photo of the base and body to confirm material (stainless steel vs. coated metal).
A video of the kettle on an induction stove to confirm compatibility.
A video of the kettle boiling water and the whistle activating.
response.reason: The item is identifiable as a whistling kettle, but key claims like 3L capacity, stainless steel material, and induction compatibility cannot be verified from the current photos. These factors significantly affect price and buyer suitability, so proof is required before pricing.
